Ow...''
''Should I get some salve for it?''
''Never mind, let me get through this first.''

''It seems a lot of visitors have been getting sick lately.''
''Hope there's enough medicine to go around.''
}} {{Dialogue Start}} :'''Zhonglin:''' Yes, it's nice to have someone to chat with. This is relaxing for me. :'''Zhonglin:''' To be honest, I still feel a lingering fear whenever I think about the Temporal Disruption in Mt. Firmament. Even though it's in the past now, I'm still tense as a tightrope. :{{DIcon}} Why is that? :'''Zhonglin:''' It's just that I'm worried I won't be able to manage everything or that the supplies in my shop might run short. :'''Zhonglin:''' Things were dire at the time. It was inevitable that people would get hurt even with [[Jinhsi|the Magistrate]] and Lady [[Xinyi]] holding down the fort. :'''Zhonglin:''' That's why I've seen a lot of patients lately. Some have injuries that could cause complications later if not treated correctly. :{{DIcon}} Your hard work is appreciated. :'''Zhonglin:''' I can't deny it's hard work, but it's also my duty as a healer to treat patients.
